newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican Cetes good bet, says Bear Stearns.
newsitem.headline: Mexican Cetes good bet, says Bear Stearns.

text.p: With the peso at about 8.0 per dollar, Mexican Cetes are an attractive bet, especially in the 91- and 182-day terms, Bear Stearns analyst Tula P. Vera said in a report.
"We had argued that the recent depreciation in the peso is likely to be relatively contained and is not altogether unwelcome," he said.
The analyst said that the move to a year-end exchange rate of 8.0 to 8.2 per dollar was long-expected and is now taking place, although in a volatile manner.
"We believe that we are now close to the end of this period of volatility and that further peso weakness is now limited," the brokerage said.
